_comment: The entire credit economy. Every number here is editable live from the dev panel — no redeploy. dailyCredits refresh each day; topup credits stack on top and do not expire.

fairUseHardCeiling._comment: Absolute daily spend ceiling per tier even if they buy topups — stops a scripted-abuse blowout. Set high; normal users never see it.

promo._comment: Set multiplier > 1 for a bonus-credits event (e.g. 2 = double daily credits). 1 = normal.
